time_rules.calendar_dates: date; preserve the selected Seoul calendar date without UTC conversion
time_rules.event_instants: timestamptz; ISO 8601 with offset on input, displayed in Asia/Seoul
time_rules.actual_duration: entered work minutes, not forced to equal wall-clock end minus start

triggers: plans_before_update increments revision_no only when plan content changes
plans_after_write snapshots initial and changed plan versions

plan_revisions.app_access: read only; plan triggers insert snapshots

indexes: (plan_id, due_on, id) where deleted_at is null

checks: undone_at is null or undone_at >= completed_at
task_completions.app_access: read only; write through complete_task and undo_task_completion RPC

checks: next_plan_id is null or next_plan_id <> plan_id

relationships: tasks 1:N task_completions history with at most one active

functions.complete_task(uuid, uuid): task row lock, request_key idempotency, at most one active completion
functions.review_summary(uuid): aggregates all tasks of plan_id with deleted_at is null

calculations.task_deleted: deleted_at is not null; excluded from current list and review, retained in export
calculations.task_completed: exists task_completions with matching task_id and undone_at is null
calculations.planned_count: count live tasks of plan_id; independent of due_on and review period
calculations.completed_count: count live tasks with active completion
calculations.overdue_count: count live tasks without active completion and due_on < Seoul today
calculations.blocked_count: count distinct live tasks having at least one work_log with nonblank blocker_reason
calculations.estimated_minutes: sum estimated_minutes of live tasks, or 0
calculations.actual_minutes: sum actual_minutes of all work_logs attached to live tasks, or 0
calculations.review_period: period_start and period_end are review metadata, not a filter for base C28-C32 summary

access: RLS enabled on six tables. anon/authenticated: public read on all; insert/update on plans, tasks, work_logs, reviews; plans updates limited to six content columns; completion changes through RPC. No browser service-role/secret key or DB password.
